whatsNew.title: A fresh PayDrift experience
whatsNew.summary: PayDrift has been redesigned end-to-end: modern layout, paycheck envelope view, dark mode, faster loading, and improved mobile and accessibility on the flows you use every day.
highlights: Redesigned Dashboard, Bills & Debts (with live debt interest preview), Income, Savings, Reports, Settings, Household, Support, and Changelog
Paycheck plan envelope with paid vs. remaining amounts and checklist on Dashboard and Income
Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation with safe-area spacing
Dark mode in Settings → App → Appearance (Light, Dark, or System)
Code-split routes and tab-level loading for faster first paint
Skip link, modal focus trap, ARIA labels, and 44px touch targets on primary controls
What's New panel on Dashboard plus full changelog page

entries.description: Major UI redesign: design system tokens, refreshed navigation, dark mode, and polish across core personal-finance pages.
Appearance settings: Light, Dark, or System theme — saved on this device.
Debt interest preview in add/edit debt modals: estimated monthly interest and payoff timeline from balance, APR, and minimum payment.
Paycheck plan envelope on Dashboard and Income with checklist, overdue handling, and pull-forward actions.
Performance pass: lazy-loaded routes, Bills/Debts tab splitting, and deferred heavy components.
Accessibility and mobile pass: skip to content, keyboard-friendly modals, improved contrast, and larger tap targets.
Household shared bills and shopping list styling aligned with the new design system; duplicate interest preview row removed in debt modals.
Bills, Debts, Income, and Payments modals now use design-system form inputs and buttons; paycheck checklist has larger touch targets; interest preview logic consolidated.
